instruction: Candid documentary photograph, wide full shot, slightly high angle. Inside a spacious motion capture studio featuring a dark red carpeted floor and white walls, the man in the black cap and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left, embracing the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) who stands on the right. The man (R1) has his right arm wrapped around her shoulder, while the woman (R2) wraps her arm around his waist, lifting her left leg slightly in a playful pose. They both face away from the camera, standing close together. Bright overhead indoor lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the floor.
